records.name: National Institute of Event Management (NIEM)
records.description: National Institute of Event Management (NIEM) Mumbai is one of India's pioneering event management education institutions, offering diploma, postgraduate, and certificate programs in event management, wedding planning, and entertainment management. It has trained thousands of event professionals who now work across corporate events, entertainment, sports, and social event industries. NIEM maintains industry partnerships with leading event companies for practical training and placement.

records.name: Gujarat Ayurved University
records.description: Gujarat Ayurved University (GAU) in Jamnagar is India's first and premier Ayurveda university, established in 1967, and home to the internationally acclaimed Jamnagar IPGT&RA (Institute of Post Graduate Teaching and Research in Ayurveda). It offers BAMS, MD Ayurveda, and Ph.D. programs and is a World Health Organization collaborating center for traditional medicine. GAU is the apex institution for Ayurvedic research and clinical training in India.

records.name: Dr. B.R. Sur Homoeopathic Medical College
records.description: Dr. B.R. Sur Homoeopathic Medical College, Hospital and Research Centre in New Delhi is one of the leading homoeopathic colleges in northern India, affiliated with Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University. It offers BHMS and MD (Homoeopathy) programs with emphasis on both classical and contemporary homeopathic practice. The institution's teaching hospital sees a large number of patients daily, providing students with rich clinical training experience.

records.name: Father Muller Homoeopathic Medical College
records.description: Father Muller Homoeopathic Medical College in Mangalore is a prestigious private homoeopathic institution under Father Muller Charitable Institutions, affiliated with Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences. It offers BHMS and MD (Homoeopathy) programs with excellent infrastructure, a well-stocked pharmacy, and a large teaching hospital. The college is known for its research activities and community outreach programs in homoeopathic healthcare.

records.name: RAK College of Nursing
records.description: RAK College of Nursing in New Delhi is affiliated with AIIMS and Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, offering B.Sc. Nursing, Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing, M.Sc. Nursing, and Ph.D. programs. It is one of the top nursing colleges in North India, known for its strong clinical training at major Delhi hospitals and its research-oriented curriculum. The college trains nurses for leadership roles in hospital administration, critical care, and community health.

records.name: CMC Vellore (Nursing)
records.description: Christian Medical College (CMC) Vellore's College of Nursing is one of India's oldest and most reputed nursing institutions, offering B.Sc., M.Sc., and Ph.D. nursing programs. CMC Vellore's nursing programs are internationally recognized, and graduates work in leading hospitals in India and abroad including the US, UK, and Gulf countries. The college is known for its Christian values-based compassionate care approach, research culture, and community health outreach.

records.name: Jamia Hamdard (Pharmacy)
records.description: Jamia Hamdard (Hamdard University) in New Delhi is a deemed university established by the Hamdard National Foundation, renowned for its Faculty of Pharmacy which is consistently ranked among India's top pharmacy schools. It offers B.Pharm., M.Pharm., Pharm.D., and Ph.D. programs and houses the Hamdard Laboratories complex, connecting academic pharmacy with industrial practice. Jamia Hamdard is also well-known for its Unani medicine programs and is a significant institution for Muslim minority education.

records.name: Bombay College of Pharmacy
records.description: Bombay College of Pharmacy in Mumbai is one of India's oldest and most prestigious pharmacy institutions, established in 1957 and affiliated with the University of Mumbai. It offers B.Pharm., M.Pharm., and Ph.D. programs and is known for its strong research in natural products, drug delivery systems, and pharmaceutical chemistry. BCP maintains industry ties with the pharmaceutical giants of the Maharashtra pharma corridor and consistently places graduates in top companies.

records.name: BITS Pilani (Pharmacy)
records.description: BITS Pilani's Department of Pharmacy is part of one of India's most prestigious private technical universities, offering an integrated M.Pharm. (5-year) and Ph.D. programs in pharmaceutical sciences. The program at BITS benefits from the university's strong industry practice school system, placing students for semester-long internships at leading pharmaceutical and biotech companies. BITS Pilani pharmacy graduates are highly respected in the industry for their strong analytical and research skills.

records.name: Bombay Veterinary College
records.description: Bombay Veterinary College in Mumbai is one of India's oldest and most reputed veterinary colleges, established in 1886, and affiliated with Maharashtra Animal and Fishery Sciences University. It offers B.V.Sc. & A.H., M.V.Sc., and Ph.D. programs with strong clinical training at Mumbai's Bai Sakarbai Dinshaw Petit Hospital for Animals and the Pinjrapole animal shelter. The college is known for its small animal practice, equine medicine, and wildlife veterinary programs.
